name: app-black-yellow-video-editor-phone-in-silhouette-hands
title: Yellow Video Editor in Silhouette Hands
whatItIs: A cover with black silhouetted hands holding a phone with a dark video editing UI and a yellow timeline, plus floating volume and animation cards and a year pill.
whatItMeans: Black hands and a warm yellow glow keep focus on the editing controls, and floating cards explain features at a glance.
techniques: Silhouetted hands merging with the dark background
Yellow accent for playhead, buttons and glow
Floating feature cards outside the phone
Amber light leak from the left
Small logo chips top left and year top right

vocabulary.definition: A warm glow bleeding into the edge of an image.
The marker showing the current position on a timeline.
A UI card pulled outside the device to highlight a feature.
